issue.title: test_load_merged_config_discards_build_invalidated_by_concurrent_clear join timeout under loaded check lane
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/test_config_cache.py::test_load_merged_config_discards_build_invalidated_by_concurrent_clear`
- **Repro:** `sase tool run check` in workspace sase_19 during wait_target rebase conflict repair (ToolRun `1f6e27ebc5d389a1c2de42c4e230e2a9`)

The node failed once in the scoped `just check` lane (`assert not builder.is_alive()` after `join(timeout=2.0)`, load1 ~16–19). An immediate isolated rerun of the same node plus the wait_target tests passed this node in 0.04s on the same tree.

The test starts a thread inside patched `merge_config_sources`, calls `clear_config_cache()`, then releases the thread and joins with a 2s timeout. Under host load the merge can still be running at join expiry, so the assertion is a timeout, not a published-stale-build failure. Wait_target conflict repair does not touch `sase.config.core`.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once in sase_19 just check ToolRun 1f6e27ebc5d389a1c2de42c4e230e2a9 (builder.is_alive after join 2.0s, load1 16-19). Isolated rerun of the same node passed in 0.04s on the unchanged tree. Serial vs parallel: red only in the loaded 8-worker scoped lane.

issue.creation_reason: just check failed this node under a loaded scoped lane, then the same node passed in isolation on an unchanged tree, so it belongs as a flake report rather than a wait_target merge defect.

payload.description: Same tests/test_config_cache.py file and full-lane/pass-isolation shape; this node is a 2s join timeout under load, not the closed cache-poisoning class.
